name: protrusion_enclosure
description: Protrusion-to-enclosure membrane mechanics (eukaryogenesis S3). A host protrusion of finite membrane area extends at an observed rate and attempts to wrap a bacterial partner; enclosure succeeds, per partner radius, only when the available area covers the partner AND adhesion clears the Helfrich bending cost. Over a partner-radius ensemble it emits an enclosure PROBABILITY, so morphology alone does not imply engulfment. topology selects classical engulfment, inside-out wrapping, or a no-enclosure control. Deterministic, coarse-grained first fidelity.

protrusion_area_um2.description: Membrane area the host protrusion can deploy (um^2)

adhesion_energy_kT.description: Total adhesion energy available on wrapping (kT); must clear 8*pi*kappa

emitter.doc:
Store historical states in memory.

``subsample`` records only every Nth composite tick (default 1 =
every tick). Use this for long runs or composites with heavy
state (large fields, many agents) to keep RAM bounded — the
saved time-series still reflects the simulation's true cadence
via each row's ``global_time`` field.

``max_len`` optionally bounds ``history`` to the most recent N
recorded rows (a ring buffer): once the cap is reached each new
record drops the oldest. Default ``None`` = unbounded (the
historical behaviour — consumers such as v2ecoli that read the
full ``history`` are unaffected unless they opt in). ``max_len``
counts *recorded* rows (i.e. post-``subsample``).
